notes.title: Choo-Choo! The Train Rides! 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
[b]An update has been released for Choo-Choo! The Train Rides![/b]

[list]
[*] Updated leaderboards player display
[*] Updated shaders
[*] Fixed sound effects stuttering
[*] Fixed crashes caused by Steam Leaderboards entries processing
[*] Fixed a couple typos in menus
[*] A lot of other untracked bugfixes
[/list]
